edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender and used for ownership and transfer origin.
Caller-derived sender flows into the core transfer routine.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance consumption.
block.timestamp is submitted as the router swap deadline, making execution miner-time dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline during trading launch.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth when the contract holds tokens and swapping is enabled.
_transfer forwards the contract ETH balance to the fee address after swapping.
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _transferStandard.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call while the inSwap lock guards only part of the flow.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth reads the stored router address for the swap call.
The external router swap can re-enter the transfer path through the payable receive fallback before state is settled.
sendETHToFee performs the native ETH transfer to the fee address.
sendETHToFee reads _feeAddress as the transfer destination.
createPair calls the Uniswap factory to deploy the pair.
createPair stores the returned pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
createPair assigns the router instance used for later swaps.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract balance as value.
openTrading approves the router for the total supply before adding liquidity.
openTrading reads the configured router for liquidity and approvals.
openTrading enables automatic swapping by setting swapEnabled.
openTrading activates the max transaction limit by setting removeMaxTx.
openTrading writes the new max transaction amount.
openTrading grants an unlimited allowance on the pair token to the router.
manualswap lets the owner trigger the swap routine with the full contract balance.
manualsend lets the owner push the contract ETH balance to the fee address.
setBots writes blacklist flags into the bots mapping.
delBot clears a blacklist flag in the bots mapping.
setremoveMaxTx toggles the removeMaxTx state flag.
_setSellTax writes the sell tax state variable.
setBuyTax writes the buy tax state variable.
_setMaxTxAmount writes the max transaction state variable.
renounceOwnership irreversibly clears the privileged owner state variable.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance through _approve.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance mapping entries.
_transferStandard takes the team portion of the tax.
_transferStandard reflects the fee portion of the tax.
_transferStandard performs reflection balance additions and subtractions.
_takeTeam multiplies the team amount by the reflection rate.
_reflectFee performs supply arithmetic on the reflection totals.
_reflectFee decreases _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee.
_getValues computes reflection amounts from tax slots and the current rate.
_transfer reads the fee-exclusion flags to decide whether tax applies.
_transfer compares from/to against the pair address to detect buys and sells.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard before triggering the swap.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping contract tokens.
_transfer checks removeMaxTx before enforcing the max transaction amount.
_transfer enforces amount against _maxTxAmount on buys.
_transfer rewrites the _feeAddr1 tax slot.
_transfer rewrites the _feeAddr2 tax slot from buy/sell tax values.
_transfer loads the sell tax when the destination is the pair.
_transfer loads the buy tax when the source is the pair.
transfer routes execution into the core _transfer routine.
transferFrom routes execution into the core _transfer routine.

onlyOwner gates openTrading on the stored owner address.
onlyOwner gates setBots blacklisting on the stored owner address.
onlyOwner gates manualswap on the stored owner address.
onlyOwner gates manualsend on the stored owner address.
onlyOwner gates _setMaxTxAmount on the stored owner address.
onlyOwner gates _setSellTax on the stored owner address.
onlyOwner gates setBuyTax on the stored owner address.
onlyOwner gates setremoveMaxTx on the stored owner address.
onlyOwner gates delBot on the stored owner address.
renounceOwnership authorizes via _msgSender() comparison against _owner.
from parameter selects the taxed source and blacklist check in _transfer.
to parameter selects the taxed destination and pair checks in _transfer.
amount parameter is validated and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
tokenAmount parameter is the swap input size.
ETH amount parameter defines the payout to the fee address.
bots_ array entries are written into the blacklist mapping.
maxTxAmount parameter conditionally replaces _maxTxAmount.
sellTax parameter conditionally replaces _sellTax.
buyTax parameter conditionally replaces _buyTax.
sender parameter is debited in the reflection balance update.
recipient parameter is credited in the reflection balance update.
tAmount parameter drives the tax and reflection computations.
currentRate local is multiplied into the team reflection amount.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter has no meaning outside _transfer; fold it into the core transfer function node.
The to parameter only participates in _transfer path and tax selection; merge into _transfer.
The amount parameter is the validated transfer size inside _transfer; merge into _transfer.
tokenAmount is consumed exclusively by the swap routine; merge into swapTokensForEth.
The ETH amount parameter is only used by the fee payout routine; merge into sendETHToFee.
bots_ is the loop input of the blacklisting routine; merge into setBots.
maxTxAmount is the guarded assignment input of _setMaxTxAmount; merge into that function.
sellTax is the bounded assignment input of _setSellTax; merge into that function.
buyTax is the bounded assignment input of setBuyTax; merge into that function.
sender is a purely local alias of the transfer source inside _transferStandard; merge into it.
recipient is a purely local alias of the transfer destination inside _transferStandard; merge into it.
tAmount is the computation seed of _transferStandard; merge into it.
currentRate is the transient rate value multiplied in _takeTeam; merge into that function.
